mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other market conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both labor conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY, indicating a strong supply side, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 during tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 3% QoQ, signaling robust demand, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, with increased confidence during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) in periods of high GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in 3 months, indicating aggressive monetary tightening, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases rapidly.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% in 2 months and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth slows to less than 100,000, the combined labor market weakness predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increase > 0.5% in 2 months and PAYEMS growth < 100,000
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) when both labor conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) growth below 2% YoY, indicating sluggish demand, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, especially during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains above 0.05 during late-cycle expansions.
